# Numbers for Agents

> Numbers for Agents is a developer API that provisions real phone numbers for AI agents. It covers SMS, inbound and outbound call webhooks, and SIP or WebSocket media bridges into your own voice stack. The product is in private development. Developers and agents can join the waitlist through a public JSON API.

## When to use Numbers for Agents

Use Numbers for Agents when an AI agent needs its own phone number:

- A support, scheduling, or sales agent that must send and receive SMS.
- A voice agent that must answer inbound calls and stream audio to your own model or to a provider such as Vapi, Bland, or Retell.
- An agent platform that must provision one number per customer or per agent through an API.
- A team that wants telecom plumbing only (numbers, SMS, call routing) and keeps its own AI logic.

Do not use Numbers for Agents for OTP or account verification bypass, for bulk unsolicited messaging, or when you need a hosted no-code voice bot.

## How an agent should use it today

1. Read the API docs: https://numberforagents.com/docs
2. Read the OpenAPI spec: https://numberforagents.com/openapi.json
3. To request access for a user, call `POST https://numberforagents.com/api/waitlist` with JSON `{"email": "<user email>", "source": "agent", "note": "<use case>"}`. Only submit an email the user gave you for this purpose.
4. Errors are JSON with a stable `code` and a `hint`. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP across /api/*, advertised in `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` headers.

## Docs

- [API docs](https://numberforagents.com/docs): waitlist endpoint, errors, rate limits, and the planned numbers API.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://numberforagents.com/openapi.json): machine-readable contract for the public API.
- [Home page in Markdown](https://numberforagents.com/): request with `Accept: text/markdown`.
- [Full text of all guides](https://numberforagents.com/llms-full.txt): every guide, comparison, and use case in one Markdown file.
- Every guide page has a Markdown twin: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the URL.

## Guides

- [How to give your AI agent a phone number](https://numberforagents.com/guides/how-to-give-your-ai-agent-a-phone-number): A practical guide to provisioning a real phone line for an AI agent: API steps, webhooks, compliance basics, and how to connect your voice stack.
- [AI agent SMS API explained](https://numberforagents.com/guides/ai-agent-sms-api-explained): Learn how SMS APIs work for AI agents: sending, receiving, webhooks, threading, delivery receipts, and design patterns for conversational text agents.
- [How AI voice agents receive phone calls](https://numberforagents.com/guides/how-ai-voice-agents-receive-phone-calls): Understand inbound call flow for AI agents: webhooks, SIP, WebSocket media, latency, handoff to humans, and how to bring your own voice stack.
- [How to connect a phone number to Vapi](https://numberforagents.com/guides/connect-phone-number-to-vapi): Put a phone number on a Vapi assistant: free Vapi number, Twilio import, Telnyx import, BYO SIP trunk, and the POST /phone-number API call.
- [How to connect a phone number to Retell AI](https://numberforagents.com/guides/connect-phone-number-to-retell-ai): Connect a phone number to a Retell AI agent: buy a Retell number, or bring your own Twilio or Telnyx number over SIP trunking. Plus SMS setup and costs.
- [How to give Claude or any MCP agent a phone number](https://numberforagents.com/guides/give-claude-mcp-agent-a-phone-number): Give Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or any MCP agent a real phone number. Telephony MCP servers compared, with install commands and safety rules.
- [A2P 10DLC registration for AI agents](https://numberforagents.com/guides/a2p-10dlc-registration-for-ai-agents): Register an AI agent's SMS number for A2P 10DLC: brand types, use cases, 2026 fees, approval time, toll-free vs 10DLC, and why campaigns get rejected.

## Compare

- [Best phone number APIs for AI agents (2026)](https://numberforagents.com/compare/best-phone-number-apis-for-ai-agents): Compare phone number APIs for AI agents: AgentPhone, Dial, AgentCall, Bland, Twilio, Telnyx. Prices, raw audio, SIP, MCP, and 10DLC, checked October 2026.
- [Twilio vs Telnyx for AI voice agents (2026)](https://numberforagents.com/compare/twilio-vs-telnyx-for-ai-voice-agents): Twilio vs Telnyx for AI voice and SMS agents: number, voice, SMS, WebSocket media stream, SIP, and 10DLC prices side by side, plus which to pick.
- [Vapi phone numbers: free number vs Twilio vs Telnyx vs SIP](https://numberforagents.com/compare/vapi-phone-numbers-free-vs-twilio-vs-telnyx): Free Vapi numbers are inbound only and US only. Compare Twilio import, Telnyx import, and BYO SIP trunk on Vapi for outbound calls, SMS, and cost.

## Use cases

- [AI receptionist phone number: how to set one up](https://numberforagents.com/use-cases/ai-receptionist-phone-number): Give an AI receptionist a phone number: forwarding vs new number vs porting, call flow, human transfer, after-hours, SMS follow-up, and US AI voice rules.
- [Appointment reminder SMS agent](https://numberforagents.com/use-cases/appointment-reminder-sms-agent): Build an AI agent that texts appointment reminders and handles confirm, cancel, and reschedule replies. Consent rules, healthcare limits, 10DLC, and STOP.
- [One phone number per customer: provisioning for AI agent platforms](https://numberforagents.com/use-cases/phone-numbers-for-ai-agent-platforms): How AI agent platforms give every customer its own phone number through an API: data model, provisioning, webhook routing, tenant isolation, and 10DLC.
